newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN EXPRESS, VISA SETTLE LITIGATION.
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN EXPRESS, VISA SETTLE LITIGATION.

text.p: American Express Co and Visa U.S.A. settled litigation regarding use of the words "platinum" and "platinum card" on their respective credit cards.
Under the deal, Visa card distributors will be able to use the words "platinum" and "platinum card" as long as the card's original issuer is clearly identified.
"It is important that consumers can distinguish our platinum card from other products in the market place," Alfred Kelly, an American Express executive, said in a statement.
Visa's Paul Allen, separately said, "This settlement will only increase the highly competitive nature of the payment card industry, which ultimately benefits consumers worldwide."
